_meta.description: Mixer pools and entry points on Polygon PoS that Exchequer screens a trace against. A trace stops at one: a mixer pays out from a commingled pool, so transfers leaving it have no established link to the deposit that arrived.
_meta.provenance: Mixer pools and entry points the 11 Nov 2026 mixer hunt found in each project's own deployment list (Tornado Cash classic UI networkConfig.js and docs, Cyclone Protocol docs) or in explorer tags (brianleect/etherscan-labels @923aba7), each checked on chain: contract code present and, for a pool, its denomination() (Cyclone: coinDenomination()/tokenDenomination()) matching its name. Re-checked for contract code 14 Nov 2026. Privacy protocols (Railgun, Aztec, Hinkal) were left out: no enforcement action names them a mixer.
_meta.verification_note: Each entry is a contract a mixer's own deployment list or an explorer tag names as its pool or entry point, with code on this chain. It says the funds passed through a mixer; it does NOT say any depositor or withdrawer took part in a crime. Tornado Cash was removed from the OFAC SDN list on 21 Mar 2025, so a Tornado Cash entry is not a sanctions listing.
_meta.category_note: 'mixer' marks pools and entry points where deposits commingle; a trace stops there.
_meta.regenerate_with: Added by hand from the 11 Nov 2026 mixer hunt; check each address on the explorer before adding another (data/mixer_pools.json rule).
_meta.schema: labels maps an address to {category, entity, label, source}
